title: i used fable 5.2 to make this wizard sandbox game 🧙‍♂️
author: najsonepls
selftext:
A browser sandbox where you're a wizard with nine spells and a hamlet that really breaks: fire that spreads, a black hole, a tornado, winding back time, and a cut you draw across the screen.

All the code was written by Claude Fable 5.2 in Claude Code. I directed and playtested. The loop was simple: it changes one thing, gives me a build, I play it and say what feels wrong, repeat. The world is drawn entirely by code, with no models or textures, and every building is separate stones and beams on GPU physics (three.js + WebGPU), so things break the way you hit them.

What made it work was letting it check itself. It runs the game headless, takes before and after screenshots of the same shot, and measures things like frame time, so I mostly reviewed builds that already worked. Where it's weak is feel. The slicing spell took a lot of rounds of me saying "still feels flat" before it landed. It also can't hear, so I judged all the sound, and it over-builds if you let it, which is why small steps mattered.

Not AI: the wizard and his animations are from Mixamo and the sounds are recorded libraries. The spell icons came from an image model.

Alpha is free in the browser if you want to try:

[https://patch.gg/play/blendi/small-magic](https://patch.gg/play/blendi/small-magic)
